title: Spicy Caramel Chicken
description: Chef John's updated spicy caramel chicken recipe features browned caramelized chicken chunks with hot and sweet peppers simmered in ginger-soy sauce.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce, or to taste
2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
0.5 cup sliced, seeded mild red chilies or bell peppers
0.5 cup chopped green onions, plus more for garnish

steps.text: Whisk brown sugar, vinegar, fish sauce, garlic, ginger, hot sauce, and soy sauce together in a large bowl.
Place chicken in a separate bowl. Add ¼ cup brown sugar sauce; toss until chicken well coated. Set aside for 15 minutes.

Heat vegetable oil in a heavy skillet over high heat until oil starts to smoke. Add chicken in a single layer; cook and stir until chicken starts to caramelize and turn deep brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Reduce heat to medium. Stir in jalapeños and red peppers, peanuts, and ½ cup green onions; cook and stir, 1 minute. Add remaining brown sugar sauce; simmer until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes.
Off heat, stir in cilantro. Serve over hot cooked rice; top with chopped green onions.

video.description: In this video, Chef John shares his updated recipe for Spicy Caramel Chicken. This flavorful dish of stir-fried chicken with peanuts, herbs, and sauce is the total package. It’s got the sweetness of brown sugar, the heat of Sriracha, and plenty of umami from soy and fish sauces. Enjoy over rice with sliced green onions.
